cases.stimulus: new-lease-first-sign: Reopen lease in standalone process before first signing
cases.expected_obligation: Fresh empty authority refuses; installing key/all-features cannot substitute.

cases.stimulus: new-lease-publication: Call existing publisher while original lease held or after it is lost
cases.expected_obligation: Busy or absent original-operation authority; no new receipt authority inferred.

cases.stimulus: visible-terminal: Valid-looking terminal survives a failed/unknown operation
cases.expected_obligation: Terminal/readback/resync cannot reconstruct original successful state.

cases.stimulus: authenticated-message-only: Authenticated peer supplies message but original destination success not established
cases.expected_obligation: Authentication alone cannot admit signing/publication.

cases.stimulus: witness-only: Supply valid witness but no admitted current original publication operation
cases.expected_obligation: Witness is not new publication authority.

cases.stimulus: same-original-clone: Compare legitimate same-operation clone with independently opened/off-host context
cases.expected_obligation: Keep original clone semantics; no claim that different process shares its Arc.

cases.stimulus: Substitute backup_id from another operation or repeat a stale request
cases.expected_obligation: Reject before new signing/receipt writing; no caller boolean, generic token or same-ID reconstruction.

cases.stimulus: Substitute attempt_id from another operation or repeat a stale request
cases.expected_obligation: Reject before new signing/receipt writing; no caller boolean, generic token or same-ID reconstruction.

cases.expected_obligation: Reject before new signing/receipt writing; no caller boolean, generic token or same-ID reconstruction.

cases.stimulus: disconnect-before-final: Disconnect before original evidence final success
cases.expected_obligation: Do not grant new authority; remote outcome may be unknown, not proven rollback.

cases.stimulus: disconnect-after-sign: Lose communication after witness signing but before verified receipt result
cases.expected_obligation: Preserve UNKNOWN/HOLD, no automatic same-ID re-sign/publication.

cases.stimulus: cancel-before-consume: Cancellation wins before final authority consumption
cases.expected_obligation: Revoke still-revocable new permission; no later write after cancellation.

cases.stimulus: late-revocation: Real successful commit wins before late disconnect/revocation
cases.expected_obligation: Preserve actual historical committed result; revoke future uses only, not erase history.

cases.stimulus: publication-result-unknown: Receipt may be visible but final result cannot be established
cases.expected_obligation: No success inference or automatic repair; distinguish old verified receipt read contract.

cases.stimulus: Repeat the same backup_id with a new attempt_id while persisted admission/stage/final residue exists
cases.expected_obligation: Reject by backup_id; a fresh attempt_id cannot evade existing residue. Before durable admission, do not fabricate on-disk ID consumption; no automatic retry within failed invocation.

cases.stimulus: unrelated-prior-complete: New transfer/publication fails beside a prior genuinely complete backup
cases.expected_obligation: Preserve prior CompleteBackup bytes and historical authority, not merely prior sealed fixture.

cases.stimulus: historical-reopen: Open a previously genuinely verified signed complete receipt with exact proof
cases.expected_obligation: Destination/trust only; do not require live source or grant new same-ID publication.

cases.stimulus: real-first-sign
cases.expected_obligation: Real independently operated destination, custody and reviewed build; original successful destination operation signs via genuine admitted binding.

cases.stimulus: real-new-publication
cases.expected_obligation: Original source protection and genuine admitted destination evidence/signature produce a new normally verified CompleteBackup.

cases.stimulus: real-normal-full-recovery
cases.expected_obligation: Normal CompleteBackup through existing full engine, complete rows/assets/authorization and job/effect checks.

cases.stimulus: real-source-unavailable
cases.expected_obligation: After separate exact isolation approval, second new target recovers from destination/trust/captured proof only, source calls zero.
